ModMetaData.name: RimMandrake Pits
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
The earth that swallows: a species-agnostic covered-pit-trap framework.
Dig a pit in stages, arm it with a terrain-mimic cover, and let mass do the rest: enough weight crosses the cover and the floor lies, dropping whoever stood on it into the hole below. Escape is a struggle clock scored off bodysize, health and manipulation, not a coin flip. The same holder class doubles as a gated holding-platform pit cell for prisoners, where closing the gate is the mercy and leaving it open under the sun is the cruelty.
This is the CORE framework only: dig-stage lifecycle, terrain-sampled cover graphics, mass-sum trigger, struggle escape, the floor-fitting family (bare / spiked / oiled / poison / deep-water / oubliette), and the holding-platform pit cell. No species bonuses, no theology, no droid-labor integration, no art pass — those live in the campaign layer per design/Jawa/covered_pit_traps_spec.md section 9. Full spec: design/Jawa/covered_pit_traps_spec.md. Built for RIMMANDRAKE_PITS_BUILD_1; the spawn-mass quicktest matrix (squirrel/human/ thrumbo/centipede x cover tiers) is the verification step this build enables but does not itself run.
